<text:style bold="true">Artistic Tools</text:style>

<image:base64 col="0" width="16" wrap="none"></image:base64>

The Artistic Tools panel holds the tools for freehand and creative drawing, the
paint bucket, the eyedropper and the control of the light. All the buttons are
always active, except the Light of the layer, which needs materials in the layer.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Pen</text:style>
Draw freehand: the stroke is a smooth vector curve, and its points can be
moved afterwards.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Marker</text:style>
Freehand with a thick stroke, like a marker. It is a vector curve too:
thickness and colour can be changed later.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Airbrush</text:style>
Sprays dots along the path that you draw. The radius of the spray, the size
of the dots and their density are in the properties; the dots are vector
       objects.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Paint bucket</text:style>
Click inside an area closed by lines or curves to fill it: the fill follows
its boundaries when they change. A click on the background gives the colour
       to the background of the layer. On a selection of a raster picture it fills
       the selected pixels. It has no stroke: whatever colour you change while it is
       active (the primary or the secondary one) changes its Fill Color.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Eyedropper</text:style>
Click a point to take its colour, whether the point belongs to a raster
picture or to a vector drawing. The left button gives the primary colour, the
       right button the secondary one.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Light of the layer</text:style>
Opens the window of the light that falls on the materials of the active
layer: its direction (with a dial), its height above the page, the spread of
       the beam, its power and its dominant colour. The changes are seen at once.
       The button is active only when the layer has objects made of materials.<text:style bold="true"></text:style>
       <text:style bold="true">Active when:</text:style> the active layer contains at least one object whose stroke or
       fill is a material; otherwise it is grayed.
